_comment: hermes3:8b was chosen by measurement on a 12GB card (local-ai-benchmarks, TOOL-CALLING.md, 2026-10-04): right tool decisions, no needless calls, and it ignored instructions planted in tool results. Before switching, compare a model with ARYNWOOD_EVAL_MODEL=<model> pytest tests/ -m eval; change `model` here and the personas in models.json to match, so one model stays loaded. max_tool_rounds caps the desktop's pre-chat loop per server; max_agent_rounds is only a backstop for the gateway's conversational loop, which normally ends when the model answers.
